Korea's Brokerages Expand Global Reach From Wall Street to Europe

In London, Europe's financial hub, interest in the Korean stock market has grown sharply as it has recorded the highest gain among major national indices worldwide since last year. Korean brokerages operating in London have taken on the role of "salesmen" explaining the Korean capital market as a whole, beyond simply serving as brokers connecting Korean stock orders. The London subsidiary of Samsung Securities held a "Korea Capital Market Conference" jointly with the Korea Exchange (KRX) at the end of last year, and this October it is preparing a joint marketing tour starting in London and traveling to Stockholm, Milan, and Zurich. The focus is on introducing not only Korean companies but also the Korean stock market and investment environment as a whole. "In the past, there were many questions focused on corporate earnings, but recently the Korean capital market itself has become the core topic," said Cho Wan-jin, head of Samsung Securities' London subsidiary, describing the mood.
